item.text: [{"task_id":"f15e1fac","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    background = int(round(params['values'][0]))","    ray = int(round(params['values'][1]))","    marker = int(round(params['values'][2]))","    step = int(round(params['values'][3]))","    origin = int(round(params['values'][4]))","    positive = int(round(params['shifts'][0]))","    negative = int(round(params['shifts'][1]))","    if step <= origin or background == ray or ray == marker:","        return grid.copy()","    chosen = None","    rotation = origin","    for value in params['rotations']:","        k = int(round(value))","        candidate = np.rot90(grid, k)","        points = np.argwhere(candidate == ray)","        if len(points) > origin and np.all(points[:, 0] == origin):","            chosen = candidate.copy()","            rotation = k","            break","    if chosen is None:","        return grid.copy()","    height, width = chosen.shape","    seeds = np.argwhere(chosen[origin] == ray).flatten().tolist()","    markers = np.argwhere(chosen == marker)","    if len(markers) == origin:","        return grid.copy()","    left = np.count_nonzero(markers[:, 1] == origin)","    right = np.count_nonzero(markers[:, 1] == width - step)","    direction = positive if left > right else negative","    shift = origin","    for row in range(origin, height, step):","        if np.any(markers[:, 0] == row):","            shift += direction","        for column in seeds:","            target = column + shift","            if origin <= target < width:","                if chosen[row, target] == background or chosen[row, target] == ray:","                    chosen[row, target] = ray","    return np.rot90(chosen, -rotation).copy()"],"shapes":{"values":[5],"shifts":[2],"rotations":[4]},"params":{"values":[0,8,2,1,0],"shifts":[1,-1],"rotations":[0,1,2,3]},"rationale":"Extend each cyan border seed inward. At every red marker's perpendicular coordinate, shift all rays one cell away from the marker's border, beginning at that coordinate. Rotate to a common orientation and restore the original orientation afterward; rays leaving the grid disappear."}]
